Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely declared the task complete and selected option A based on a flawed rationale that limited “largest stars” to main-sequence stars (~10 solar radii), ignoring supergiants/hypergiants that are hundreds to over a thousand solar radii. This misinterpretation led to choosing A instead of the correct answer B (“The sun would be tiny next to one of the largest stars”). The Planner also failed to follow the process instructions (no specialist engagement or systematic verification).
